subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should enabling `tools.elevated` for an allowed sender keep sandbox exec as the default unless elevation is explicit, or should the current session-wide elevated-by-default behavior remain supported?
rationale: This controls the sandbox-to-host exec boundary and can affect existing operator workflows, so automation should not choose the default or redefine `/elevated ask` without maintainer intent.

options.title: Default-Off Elevated Contract
options.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, with `/elevated on|ask|full` or `exec(elevated: true)` as explicit ways to leave the sandbox.

options.title: Keep Current Session-Wide Behavior
options.body: Document and preserve that allowed elevated sessions default to host exec and that `/elevated ask` is host exec with approvals.

options.title: Add Separate Opt-In Mode
options.body: Preserve current `on` and `ask` semantics but add a separate explicit mode for sandbox-by-default plus per-call elevation.

recommendation.title: Default-Off Elevated Contract
recommendation.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, with `/elevated on|ask|full` or `exec(elevated: true)` as explicit ways to leave the sandbox.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for this contract is the elevated ask/full mode and exec default work authored by steipete.
